source_status: current standard (Oregon Standard Drawings 2024, eff. 2026-06-01; sheets dated 20-APR-2018)
flange_width_note: Top flange width "W" is project-specific. The MINIMUM DECK REINFORCEMENT FOR INTERIOR GIRDERS table on each sheet gives W = 60 to 72, 72 to 84, 84 to 102 in; SIZES encode the minimum (60), the two table breakpoints (72, 84) and the maximum (102).
geometry_notes: END VIEW right-hand chain, bottom up: 6 in bulb edge, 3 in bulb taper (9 in run to web face, bulb 2'-0" wide), web straight (1'-3" / 2'-0" / 3'-3"), 2 in fillet over a 3 in run, 4 in flange taper over 1'-6", 6 in (min.) flange edge thickness. Chains sum to 3'-0", 3'-9", 5'-0". Web 6 in (MIDSPAN SECTION). Positions checked by pixel measurement on the 300 dpi BR360 render (all within 0.1 in).
Flange underside is flat from 2'-0" off centreline to the tip, consistent with BAR "C" (2'-0" each side, 5 in drop, total W - 4 in).
Soffit corners: 'Chamfer soffit corners 1" max.' CONVENTION: 1 in chamfer.

CONVENTION: flat top (0.02 max. slope / tilt ignored); square flange tips. The interior-flange edge connection/shear key and the 3/4 in drip v-groove of exterior flanges are undimensioned and omitted.

No section properties are printed on the ODOT sheets. Brice et al. (2021) Table A.11 Oregon BT48-BT96/BI rows are the non-deck bulb-tee/bulb-I details, not the DKBT; no published property check is available.
